Package org.krmdemo.plansinstr.equilib

Enum Class Zone

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<Zone>
org.krmdemo.plansinstr.equilib.Zone
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<Zone>, Constable
public enum Zone extends Enum<Zone>
The sweep status of a current balance, from the far left of the x axis to the far right.

"In" and "Out" are the key words of every title and are always capitalised (on the pictures they are also a bit bolder). Two statuses are a terminal failure (⏚, the mark of the AuditStatus state charts): the swept amount does not exist there (∄), one sweep cannot restore the balance.

description() is the one and only explanation of each status: the list under the picture in the README (and, word for word, on the site) is checked against it by a test.
